description: This file defines the `SystemConfigurationHelper` class, which provides methods to retrieve system details such as OS, PHP, MySQL, server, and application version information for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationHelper
classes.description: A helper class to gather system environment and configuration details for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsArray
methods.description: Returns an array with system details including OS, PHP, MySQL, server, and OHRM version information.

methods.name: getOsDetails
methods.description: Retrieves operating system details such as OS type, release name, and version info.

methods.name: getServerDetails
methods.description: Returns server software details from the $_SERVER superglobal.

methods.name: getMySqlDetails
methods.description: Provides MySQL client and server version information.

methods.name: getOHRMDetails
methods.description: Returns the current version of OrangeHRM as defined in the Config class.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsJson
methods.description: Encodes the system details array into JSON format.

methods.name: getMySqlServerVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the MySQL server version via PDO connection attributes.
